data.one_liner: Read and write Mapbox MBTiles v1.3 files with support for vector and raster tiles.
data.what_it_does: Provides support for working with Mapbox MBTiles v1.3 database files to read metadata and retrieve vector or raster tiles. Allows opening files as read-only or writable, and supports in-memory databases.
use_when: You need to read or write Mapbox MBTiles files in your app.
You want to bundle offline map tiles using raster (jpg, png, webp) or vector (pbf) formats.
avoid_when: You are targeting Flutter Web, as SQLite is not supported on web.
You want to load the MBTiles file directly from Flutter assets without copying it to the file system first.
strengths: Supports both vector and raster tiles from MBTiles files.
Allows working with file-based or in-memory databases.
weaknesses: Not supported on the web platform due to missing SQLite support.
Requires manual file copying if the MBTiles file is bundled inside Flutter assets.
data.setup_notes: For Flutter, store the MBTiles file in path_provider directories, copy it from assets if bundled, and request storage permissions if accessing internal device storage or SD cards.
